title: MCTweaks | Refined Recipes & Drops
description: This datapack adds a variety of quality-of-life improvements to Minecraft, including new crafting, smelting, and blasting recipes, as well as adjusted mob drops and behaviors. It’s designed to enhance vanilla gameplay without overcomplicating it.
body:
## 🧩 Vanilla Enhancer Datapack
This datapack enhances the vanilla Minecraft experience with a variety of quality-of-life changes and subtle tweaks, all while keeping the core gameplay intact. It adds new crafting, smelting, and blasting recipes, reworks mob drops, and adjusts mob behavior to be more player-friendly.

## 🔧 Features
### Crafting Recipes

Craft items like Tuff, Blackstone, Red Sand, Cobwebs, Nametags, and more

Shapeless crafting for Shulker Boxes

Multiple ways to craft Dispensers

Reverse crafting for Nether Wart, Ice, and Packed Ice

Reworked Furnace and Lantern recipes

### Smelting & Blasting

Smelt Rotten Flesh into Leather

Cook raw iron, copper, and gold blocks into their solid forms using furnaces or blast furnaces

### Mob Drops & Functions

Husks now drop Sand (great for sand farming)

Shulkers drop 2 shells instead of 1

Endermen no longer pick up blocks (griefing disabled)

## 💡 Notes
This pack is not updated frequently, but bug fixes and requested features may be added from time to time.

Designed for vanilla-like gameplay with slight enhancements.
